label: Cancel Jobs
mcp_tool_description: Cancel one or more running, queued, or paused CloudBolt jobs and their unfinished descendants by setting them to TO_CANCEL. Give job global ids (JOB-...), one per line or comma-separated. Finished jobs are reported as ALREADY_FINISHED. The caller must own each job or be a CloudBolt admin. Use it to recover from a hung test job before retrying.
